en: "A giant door and six statues{n} of gods, huh?"
"Just like the intel said. This land{n} seems to work as a checkpoint linking{n} the island's low and high ground..."
"The ring of the Twelve Gods is{n} ringing? It seems to be resonating{n} with those statues standing there?"
"Heh, what an elaborate production.{n} It's plain as day they're bluffing{n} to give people a scare. Honestly..."
"My name is Beauty God Venus!"
"My name is Sky God Uranus!"
"My name is Sun God Apollo!"
"My name is War God Ares!"
"My name is Silence God Selene!"
"My name is Sea God Poseidon!"
"You who seek the right to be agent of{n} the gods, who seek the rings of the{n} Zodiac Twelve Gods that seal our power!"
"Your trial is not yet over!"
"If you would go on from here, know{n} that there are but two paths!"
"One!"
"Either bind the six rings into one{n} and show them before us!"
"Or!"
"Cast away every last one of the rings!"
"What a load of crap. Throw away{n} the rings? Like hell I could do that!"
"So what you mean is, the first way{n} is the only way I've got, right?{n} You jokers sure like playing dumb!"
"Seek out the statues..."
"In lands you have visited once...{n} and in lands you have yet to visit..."
"Of the Twelve Gods' statues, first{n} find the six of us, and turn{n} our power into rings."
"Then shall the way be opened!"
"The rings you now hold..."
"The rings that yet remain..."
"Set it right."
"Too little time remains. Gain the{n} power of us Zodiac Twelve Gods and{n} set the course of this world right."
"Tch. The theatrics work, sure, but{n} it really is a well-made{n} surveillance system."
"Same logic as the complex ciphers the{n} army uses. Several strings are the key{n} to decoding. Miss any one and it fails."
"In other words, the rings themselves{n} are the password. That's the setup."
"Yes, it truly is a well-made system."
"Long, long ago, yes, in the age of{n} the gods, there was a Twelve Sages{n} system for governing the nation."
"Twelve chosen people each held a ring{n} that also served for self-defense, and{n} in times of need bound the rings..."
"...and so moved the Super Machine God,{n} the nation's guardian deity, or set{n} the course of politics, it is said."
"In short, the rings of the Zodiac{n} Twelve Gods are a symbol for moving{n} the world: proof of a chosen sage."
"Is that true?"
"No, it is merely a legend."
"Tch!"
"It uses space itself for memory. Tech{n} that bends even light and gravity to{n} its will, stores and replays them..."
"Now this is truly the work of gods!"
"A fine reference for my Item Studies!"
"Zodiac... Twelve Gods..."
"No good. I should have heard of them,{n} but the memory is lost. The key{n} points, I cannot recall at all."
"Truly, this is an art of mystery."
"Feng shui reads the ki of wind and{n} water. This art bends such natural{n} phenomena to its will and remakes them."
"Ah, to be able to hear the words{n} of the gods... What a wonderful{n} thing this is!"
"Anyway, we'll have to come back later."
"At this rate I can't even carry out{n} Special Service HQ's orders. I've got{n} to gather the other rings, and fast."
"Let's go!"
"To set{w:1}..."
"You who seek the right to be agent of{n} the gods, who seek the rings of the{n} Zodiac Twelve Gods that seal our power!"
"Your trial is not yet over!"
"Of the twelve, the keys to this path,{n} the six rings that are the substance{n} of us six demigods, are unsealed!"
"And yet!"
"They are not yet bound into one!"
"Tch. For so-called gods, you sure{n} are fussy about the little things."
"There is ever but one agent of the gods!"
"Therefore, in the name of the Zodiac{n} Twelve Gods, show before us, here,{n} your power as agent of the gods..."
"That, we declare, is the final{n} trial given unto you!"
"Hey? What's that supposed to mean?"
"Oh my? My, my, my!?{n} Wherever could this beee?"
"I see..."
"So the ones holding the rest of the{n} rings we failed to collect were{n} you people after all..."
"I see..."
"So the ones holding the rest of the{n} rings we failed to collect are{n} you people standing over there..."
"There is ever but one agent of the gods!"
"Take up arms against each other, and{n} now cross swords in fierce contest!"
"Know that mighty power exists for{n} one reason: to set right the course{n} of the world!"
"The one who survives the battle{n} before the gods is the true agent!{n} Come! Take up your arms, both of you!"
"And make an offering to us of{n} your opponent's blood and entrails!"
"Naval gunfire!"
"Whaaat!?"
"The shells are landing before the{n} sound! Long-range fire, big-bore guns!{n} By the bearing, it's from the sea!?"
"Don't tell me... a battleship!?"
"No waaay!? Fight each other!?{n} Are the Zodiac Twelve Gods telling{n} us to commit murdeeer?"
"I see..."
"If that's what the gods have to say,{n} I can pretty much guess what this{n} island's Almighty Treasure is like..."
"Buuut..."
"That's iiit! I'm sure this{n} is all a test for uuus!"
"Huh?"
"Don't you think sooo? I'm sure whoever{n} really fights here won't be{n} chosen as the ageeent!"
"Whether we're people who love to{n} fight: I'm sure that's what{n} the gods are testiiing!"
"Are you stupid, lady?"
"If the gods were so kind, would they{n} have told anyone about an Almighty{n} Treasure, a sure seed of strife?"
"Well?"
"Since every country's army poured{n} into this island, how many have{n} died? Ten? A hundred? A thousand?"
"Gods who'd condemn murder wouldn't{n} have let all the mass killing so far{n} go on, now would they!"
"You really never change: so damn{n} soft it makes me want to puke!"
"That's not likely..."
"Gods like that wouldn't have gone{n} around saying there's an Almighty{n} Treasure, fuel for a fight."
"...What is the matter?"
"You who aspire to be{n} the agent of the gods?"
"The course of the world{n} is falling into disorder."
"To set it right is the very..."
"Of course, {hero:6}."
"Ixion! What the hell were you doing!?"
"Sorry. I had a lot to prepare."
"At this rate I can't carry out the{n} mission! What does Special Service{n} HQ have to say!?"
"Special Service HQ, huh..."
"Hey? Ixion!?"
"You've done good work until now,{n} {hero:6}. But your job ends here."
"What do you mean!?"
"That is..."
"Sorry about this. I've just been{n} using you all this time."
"No!? You were using me?"
"Good grief, you're as slow as ever,{n} missus. What I was after was that{n} ring of the Zodiac Twelve Gods of yours..."
"Then when you happened to be on the{n} same ship as me, crossing over{n} to this island of steel...?"
"Right, that was no accident.{n} It was all calculated from the start."
"You bastard! You'd even betray me,{n} your one and only best friend!?"
"Best friend?"
"Good grief. To hear a word like that{n} from your mouth... Well, well,{n} I never even dreamed of it."
"Huh!?"
"What just happened!?"
"Wh-wh-wh-what is thiiis?{n} It seems nothing at all like{n} magic or special moooves!?"
"Are they aiming at us?"
"No. Not at us so much as shelling{n} every key point on this{n} island of steel, I'd say..."
"It's standard before a big landing.{n} Naval guns blow away the mines and{n} obstacles to clear the infantry's path."
"Then...?"
"Yeah. It was only special forces{n} until now, but they've run out of{n} patience. A full-scale army's coming."
"So this island of steel becomes{n} more and more of a chaotic{n} battlefield, doesn't it?"
"That's about it."
"Dammit! Speaking of which, what{n} the hell has that Ixion{n} been doing!?"
"A landing operation this big...{n} The Special Service Agency should{n} have caught wind of it long ago!"
"What!?"
"What do you mean, Diana!?"
"I see... So that's how it is!"
"Out to claw your way up in the army,{n} at first you sought this island's{n} Almighty Treasure as a mission!"
"But the more you learned of it,{n} the more you wanted the Almighty{n} Treasure in your own hands!"
"That's right. You betrayed not just{n} me, but your own country as well!"
"Am I wrong!? Ixion!?"
"Heh. You, of all people, only just{n} now noticed? That's right.{n} This is my revenge."
"Revenge?"
"I told you back when we were brats:{n} if that's the choice, I'll be one{n} who tramples, not one who's trampled."
"If I can just get{n} the Almighty Treasure..."
"I can say goodbye to a life of{n} reading my superiors' faces and just{n} taking orders, {hero:6}..."
"And then my real revenge begins!"
"Revenge on those{n} who looked down on me!"
"Too bad, but there's no time for that."
"Before long, the naval guns will{n} blow this place away without{n} leaving a trace, you see..."
"Ixion!"
"Diana, you too...?"
"I really am sorry, missus. Seems your{n} old companions are coming over{n} to our side, too."
"Well, 'stripped of everything you{n} own': so this is the kind of time{n} that saying was made for."
"It can't be!?"
"Diana, you cast a spell or{n} something on everyone, didn't you!?"
"A mere spell couldn't manage that."
"That Ixion fellow brought along{n} a certain powerful drug the{n} Rhodes army had been developing."
"A mind conditioning drug for making{n} Esper Dolls or whatever, I'm told.{n} And this stuff sure was powerful."
"In no time your companions turned{n} into something like slaves{n} who do whatever we say."
"That's a legacy of the ancient{n} civilization for you."
"But that's...!?"
"You warped people's hearts{n} with a drug, didn't you!?"
"That's just it, missus."
"A heart is so vague and flimsy{n} a drug can warp it. Even feelings{n} like love and friendship."
"That's awful! Just too awful!"
"Well, it's about time to say goodbye.{n} Get burned black by the naval guns{n} and join your hubby in the next world."
"See ya!"
"Diana, please wait!"
"Hey, Ixion!"
September 1, Divine Calendar 4199
The conflict over the island of steel{n}spread across all of North Europea.
On this day the United Republican{n}Kingdom of Rheinmetall declared war on{n}the Holy Nation of Assyria to the south.
At almost the same time, a coup broke{n}out in the Republic of Romulus; officers{n}bent on restoring the monarchy took power.
With these events as the trigger, the{n}Rheinmetall-Folgore union and the{n}Romulus-Assyria alliance were formed.
All of North Europea was to be{n}swallowed by the flames of war.
The Third Great Europea War had begun.
"So long..."
"Whaaaaat!?"
"Hey, what's wrong!?"
"The ring? My ring of the{n} Zodiac Twelve Gods!?"
"Sorry. During that shelling just now,{n} I quietly helped myself to it."
"Ixion, that woman gunslinger, too:{n} you hired her in advance with{n} your own money, didn't you?"
"Well, that's about it."
"You dirty bastard..."
"Dirty?"
"Hmph! You've been killing people{n} since you were a brat of eight.{n} That's hardly a line for you to say."
"Ixion! Take up your sword! I'll{n} settle this with you right here{n} and now!"
"This is...!?"
"Griffith! Current position!"
"Y... Yes, sir!"
"......Measurement complete!"
"Our current position is...{n} near the center of the island!"
"The island's center... The place{n} called the checkpoint, linking the{n} island's high ground and low ground..."
"I see. A giant door and six{n} statues of gods. Just like the{n} intel from HQ said."
"Me, getting pushed back?{n} Somebody cover me!"
"So strong! They're waaay too strong!?"
"No! I can't give up now!{n} Hector, cover me, pleeease!"
"Tch, not bad!"
"But I absolutely can't lose this!{n} Back me up, will you!"
"Backup! Backup!{n} Waaah! It hurts!{n} But Alice won't give up!"
"Well fought, for an enemy.{n} {name:6}, forgive me,{n} but I need your support!"
"Argh! Son of a bitch!{n} But I won't lose! Never again!{n} Backup! Send help!!"
"Am I... out of healing...?{n} ...Please... cover me..."
"Oh dear, this won't do...{n} I have run out of ways to heal."
"I'm a professor, you know!?{n} Show a little more care, will you!?{n} Hurry up and back me up!"
"Win probability down to 22%!{n} Auto-repair function: off!!{n} Requesting backup!"
"The flow of ki is gathering to the{n} enemy. I have no means of healing{n} left. Please, lend me your support."
"Mm...{n} ...Support...!"
"Lord, please send me aid!{n} I cannot lose here, for I{n} must spread Your teachings!"
"Ngh, they really are strong!{n} And I'm out of healing...{n} Backup, please!"
"Me, a soldier of Romulus, pushed{n} back by a mere foe like this...!{n} Sorry, requesting relief!"
"Li'l Tethys is in a piiinch!{n} Backup, if you please!!{n} Much obliged, yes indeed!"
"Gh...{w:1} Why...{w:1} Me, of all people..."
"I'm sorry...{w:1} Hector..."
"Guess they were...{w:1} way out of my league.{n} Sorry, I'm pulling out first!"
"Uu...{w:3} sniff...{w:3} sniff...{n} Alice...{w:3} lost...{n} Alice is going... {w:5}home..."
"Alas...{w:3} so I am beaten.{n} Forgive me, {w:3}I must withdraw."
"I can...{w:3} still fight...{w:3} I can...{n} ...Damn it! {w:3}Pulling back for now!"
"Pathetic...{w:3} Can't even die...{n} So once again, I alone {w:3}retreat...?"
"It seems...{w:3} over these centuries...{n} my magic, too...{w:3} has waned...{n} Allow me {w:3}to withdraw first!"
"Why...{w:3} did I...{w:3} lose?{n} I'm...{w:3} a professor, I tell you...{n} Retreat, {w:3}retreat! {w:3}Running is winning!"
"Damage rate...{w:3} 59.7%...{n} Self-repair {w:3}limit reached.{n} Moving to camp."
"I could not...{w:3} control the flow of ki...{n} ...{w:3}I can make...{w:3} no excuses.{n} I will...{w:3} return...{w:3} ahead of you..."
"Defeat...{n} {w:3}Withdrawing..."
"Ah...{w:3} so I have lost...{n} Lord, {w:3}forgive me...{n} I will go back {w:3}to camp {w:3}ahead of you..."
"Ngh...{w:3} I'm sorry...{n} {hero:6}...{w:3} Lieutenant, sir...{n} I'm pulling back {w:3}ahead of you..."
"...{w:3}A proud...{w:3} soldier of Romulus,{n} beaten...{w:3} so disgracefully...{n} Sorry... {w:3}I'm withdrawing!!"
"Li'l Tethys loses!{n} Withdrawing, if you please!!{n} The rest is yours, yes indeed!"
